g.text: 11 — RUNNING, IDLE, STALL, and recovery state machine

g.title: sample
g.text: Traffic callback with both CAKE qdiscs available

g.title: grace
g.text: RUNNING but still in wake grace?

g.title: age
g.text: Age since last successful latency reply

g.title: wake
g.text: health grace=2 ping periods; reset health

g.title: healthy
g.text: Enough healthy replies and sleep enabled?

g.title: quiet
g.text: Both rates <= 2 Mbit/s continuously for 60 s?

g.title: degrade
g.text: Warn once; enforce minima if enabled
restart fping if last start >=10 s
